themes.name: Cypress
themes.cardBlurb: A welcoming home for events, groups, giving, and the stories that bring a community together.
themes.description: Cypress is a community website prebuild designed to make the next step feel clear and personal. Its warm, contemporary layout gives events, groups, visits, and giving their own easy-to-find paths, while space for mission-driven stories helps explain what brings people together. The fictional Cypress Commons content shows how an organization can welcome newcomers and keep its community connected without leaning on a generic nonprofit look.

seo.title: Cypress Community Website Prebuild | AgentSam
seo.description: Explore Cypress, a warm community website prebuild with clear paths to events, groups, giving, visits, and the mission behind the work.

themes.name: Violet
themes.tagline: Make the cause impossible to scroll past.
themes.cardBlurb: Bold campaign pages pair impact proof and human stories with clear ways to give, share, volunteer, and join in.
themes.description: Violet is designed to move people from interest to involvement. Bold calls to action lead the way, while impact highlights and human stories give the campaign room to make its case. Donation moments sit alongside clear paths to volunteer, share, and join in—so participation feels like part of the story, not an afterthought.

seo.title: Violet Campaign Website Prebuild
seo.description: Explore a campaign website prebuild built around bold calls to action, impact proof, human stories, donation moments, and clear ways to take part.

themes.name: Grove
themes.tagline: Show the work. Make the craft feel premium.
themes.cardBlurb: A tactile, gallery-led home-services site that puts materials, finished projects, and estimate requests in clear view.
themes.description: Grove gives flooring and interiors businesses a visual-first website structure with room for project galleries, close-up material photography, process steps, customer reviews, and estimate requests. Warm typography, considered spacing, and grounded colors give the work a studio-quality frame without getting in the crew’s way.

seo.title: Grove — Home Services Website Prebuild
seo.description: A tactile home-services website prebuild for flooring and interiors, with project galleries, material details, process storytelling, reviews, and estimate requests.

themes.name: Ember
themes.cardBlurb: A story-first storefront for bold drops, lived-in brand worlds, and product discovery beyond the grid.
themes.description: Ember pairs expressive editorial layouts with considered shopping flows. Lead with a campaign, bring collections into focus, tell the story behind the goods, and give community a place to gather—without defaulting to a wall of product tiles.

seo.title: Ember — Editorial Commerce Website Prebuild
seo.description: Ember is an editorial commerce prebuild for bold product discovery, brand stories, collection launches, and community—without defaulting to a tiled grid.

themes.name: Forge
themes.tagline: Built to get the phone ringing.
themes.cardBlurb: A sharp local-services prebuild with upfront estimate capture, clear service areas, project proof, and trust signals that hold up on mobile.
themes.description: Forge Works shows how a trade-services website can turn a local visit into a clear next step. The prebuild puts estimate requests up front, makes service areas easy to find, and gives project proof, reviews, and practical trust details room to do their job. The layout stays direct and readable on small screens.

seo.title: Forge | Local Services Website Prebuild
seo.description: A mobile-first local services prebuild with clear estimate requests, service-area details, project photos, reviews, and practical trust signals for trade teams.

themes.name: Harbor
themes.cardBlurb: Clear service stories, thoughtful proof, and reassuring lead capture—with an editorial feel beyond corporate blue.
themes.description: Built for trust-heavy work, Harbor gives service stories room to breathe, brings proof and resources into view, and makes lead capture feel considered rather than pushy. Its restrained palette, generous spacing, and crisp typography bring a modern editorial character without defaulting to corporate blue.

seo.title: Harbor | Professional Services Website Prebuild
seo.description: A polished professional-services website prebuild with clear service pages, thoughtful proof, useful resources, and calm, confident lead capture.

themes.name: Summit
themes.cardBlurb: An editorial portfolio prebuild for expertise that travels well.
themes.description: Summit is a consulting and portfolio prebuild shaped by editorial clarity and thoughtful spacing. Its structure brings services, case studies, and media into focus, with a multilingual-ready foundation for reaching across languages and markets.

seo.title: Summit — Consulting Portfolio Prebuild
seo.description: Summit is a restrained consulting portfolio prebuild with editorial service pages, case studies, media, multilingual-ready structure, and room to think.

themes.name: Resolve
themes.cardBlurb: Cinematic scroll, shoppable stories, and a purchase rail that stays in step.
themes.description: A high-fashion commerce prebuild shaped by cinematic scroll, shoppable editorial, and sticky purchase rails. Lookbooks, stories, considered bundles, and precise micro-interactions give each page a sense of pace and intention.

seo.title: Resolve — Luxury Commerce Prebuild
seo.description: A luxury commerce prebuild with cinematic scroll, shoppable editorial, sticky purchase rails, lookbooks, and considered details for fashion-led storefronts.
